# The /api routes the home mounts that shared/api/openapi.json did not describe when
# TestOpenAPIDescribesEveryRoute began (Epic 59 story 59.16). The list only shrinks: a route
# described here, or no longer mounted, fails the test until its line goes. A new route is
# never added here; it is described instead.
